basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6+ years of experience building ecommerce applications in React, GraphQL and TypeScript, and analytics in GA4. I've handled on-call rotations and troubleshoot production systems in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS. Lately I've been building AI harnesses and tools that help developers get work done.

highlights: Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Apollo, Jest, React Testing Library, GCP, GitHub Actions, GA4, Adobe Launch, TrackJS, CommerceTools API
Own the storefront product carousel. I rebuilt it from scratch with fewer re-renders, which improved Core Web Vitals across the site.
One of four npm maintainers on pure-react-carousel (express-labs), about 67k weekly downloads and 1.7k GitHub stars. I triage issues, review community PRs and publish releases.
Led the move to Google Retail Search, which replaced keyword matching with ML-ranked results and raised search-to-purchase conversion.
Keep the components I own at 100% unit test coverage with Jest and React Testing Library, so regressions get caught before staging.
Mentor junior engineers through code review and pairing. Two of them now own features on their own.
Take on-call shifts: I troubleshoot production issues in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS, lead the response and write the postmortem.
Tech Stack: React, Bootstrap, Node.js, TypeScript, Stripe, GCP, Firebase
Built the first version of the product: designed the data model, built the frontend and shipped the first paying customer's integration.
Wrote and deployed GCP Cloud Functions for payment webhooks, user lifecycle events and background jobs.
Set up Stripe subscription billing, including webhooks, failed payment recovery and plan upgrades.
Solved high-volume inbound issues on the first call, often past the script, walking non-technical and elderly customers through setup step by step. Consistently earned top-tier satisfaction scores.

projects.name: Odin, Claude Code Plugin
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin for AI coding work: plan, execute, review, then sign-off, with a human approval gate between each step. A local dashboard shows a live diff with a written rationale. Anything that took more than one pass becomes a proposed fix to the agent's own rules. Started as a self-hosted agent runtime; now a skill.

projects.name: heap-analyzer
projects.description: A CLI wrapper around Facebook's memlab for finding memory leaks in Node.js apps. Take three heap snapshots and it diffs them, traces what's keeping each leaked object alive and shows how memory changes over time. On npm.
